name: ausm-timeline
description: every ausm sensor on one live timeline, with the materials and tasks it finds

scripts.build: tsc -p app/tsconfig.json && webpack --mode production --config app/timeline/webpack.config.js && webpack --mode production --config app/overlay/webpack.config.js
scripts.dev: tsc -p app/tsconfig.json && concurrently -k -n timeline,overlay,tsc,electron "webpack serve --mode development --config app/timeline/webpack.config.js" "webpack serve --mode development --config app/overlay/webpack.config.js" "tsc -p app/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://localhost:3002 http://localhost:3003 && NODE_ENV=development electron ."
